statements.proposition: This change is backward compatible and changes no public API or behaviour of the Tooltip component.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Impact claim. The public-API half checks out from the diff: no props, types or exports changed (only internal refs, timeout tracking and effect dependencies in Tooltip.tsx; other added files are under benchmark/). The 'no behaviour change' half is not settleable by a concrete check: the ResizeObserver effect now depends on [rendered, contentWrapperRef.current] instead of [content, ...] and is skipped until rendered, and repeated handleShow calls now cancel the earlier 10ms timer; whether any of this alters observable behaviour would need runtime testing not done here.
evidence: gh api pulls/1258/files: only source file changed is src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx (+22 -4); 9 added files under benchmark/

Tooltip.tsx patch: adds tooltipShowTimerRef, clearTimeoutRef before setTimeout in handleShow, mounted.current guard in computeTooltipPosition .then, timeoutIds Set in ResizeObserver effect; no change to component props/signature or exports
Tooltip.tsx patch: effect deps changed from '[content, contentWrapperRef?.current]' to '[rendered, contentWrapperRef?.current]' and early return 'if (!rendered || ...)'
